evaluations.claim: the MADLLM without prompt pool configuration collapses to roughly 55% in the PSM dataset
evaluations.reality: The MADLLM without prompt pool configuration in the PSM dataset is actually around 75%, not 55%. This is a significant exaggeration of the performance drop.

evaluations.claim: the MADLLM without skip embedding configuration stabilizes at around 75% in the SWaT dataset
evaluations.reality: The MADLLM without skip embedding configuration in the SWaT dataset is approximately 85%, not 75%. The term 'stabilizes' also mischaracterizes the trend.

evaluations.claim: the MADLLM without feature embedding configuration outperforms the MADLLM without prompt pool by a narrow margin in the WADI dataset, scoring approximately 68%
evaluations.reality: In the WADI dataset, the MADLLM without feature embedding configuration scores approximately 63%, which is lower than the MADLLM without prompt pool configuration at around 65%. The claim reverses their relative performance.
evaluations.reason: WADI feature embedding is ~62%, lower than prompt pool.
